scope: Isolated bootstrap/event/failure tests and actual identity function. No browser, GPU pixels or physical-device verification.
checks: Reproduced old startup identity failure with randomUUID unavailable; replacement generates compatible IDs using getRandomValues.
Portrait starts unpaused and accepts movement/menu input; keyboard preserves physical orientation, follows visual viewport and clears held input; background/native pause still works.
Rejected game import displays readable failure, opens diagnostics and pauses instead of leaving a blank world.
Failed HTTP requests retain status/path; failed required assets expose retry error.
First submitted frame dismisses loading; mobile DPR capped; context loss stops with Retry, while intentional preview disposal does not falsely fail.
Shader/link errors surface in diagnostics, not merely in a developer console.
